summary: The [2030 strategy's targets are unchanged](2025-05-13-national-digital-transformation-strategy-2030--wearetech), and the high commission [seated a scientific committee in October 2025](2025-10-29-expert-panel-digital-overhaul--wearetech).
developments:
The strategy was [published in May 2025 targeting all public services online by 2030, 500,000 information and communication technology jobs and a fifth of national output from the digital economy](2025-05-13-national-digital-transformation-strategy-2030--wearetech), [announced the day before](2025-05-12-national-digital-transformation-strategy-announced-echorouk). Its targets did not move in the window.

2025-10-23 - the high commission for digitalisation, created by decree in 2023, [seated a fifteen-member scientific and technical committee, three of them from the diaspora](2025-10-29-expert-panel-digital-overhaul--wearetech). It had been operating without one.

No delivery figure against any of the three targets is published, so what has been added is a governance organ rather than a measured position.

summary: A [joint interministerial roadmap to deploy artificial intelligence across public services was agreed in August 2026](2026-08-12-algeria-launches-public-service-ai); the strategy text is still unpublished.
developments:
The strategy was adopted by the national artificial-intelligence council in December 2024 on six pillars, and its [deployment plan was reviewed by government on 25 May 2026 ahead of a Council of Ministers adoption that is not recorded as having happened](2026-05-25-government-reviews-national-ai-strategy-elmoudjahid).

2026-08-05 - a [first interministerial meeting fixed five priorities: sovereign open-source government models, national high-performance computing, specialised training and university curricula, a national research centre with specialised units, and administrative and public data processed and hosted in national data centres, and created a follow-up commission](2026-08-05-algerie-premieres-etapes-mise-en-oeuvre-strategie-nationale-intelligence-artificielle), the [roadmap being fixed by the higher-education minister](2026-08-06-strategie-nationale-de-lintelligence-artificielle-kamel-baddari-fixe-la-feuille-de-route) and the [deployment agreed jointly](2026-08-12-algeria-launches-public-service-ai). The [underlying research and innovation strategy was drawn up by 150 national and diaspora experts](2026-08-05-intelligence-artificielle-et-souverainete-numerique-lheure-de-laction-a-sonne).

No budget, dates or implementing institutions are stated, and the strategy itself is still not published.

summary: [In-country data localisation has been in force since September 2024](2024-09-19 Algeria Digital Economy (US Country Commercial Guide)), and no global hyperscaler operates in-country.
developments:
Localisation has been [in force since September 2024, with no global hyperscaler operating in-country](2024-09-19 Algeria Digital Economy (US Country Commercial Guide)), and the [position is restated in an analysis of digital-sovereignty policy](2026-04-19-algerian-cyber-policy-digital-sovereignty-analysis-echorouk). The instrument imposing it is not itself held.

Nothing moved in the window, but what sits on top of it did: a national data centre entered service, a sovereign cloud launched on it, and the data-protection authority ruled that publishing images through platforms reachable from outside the country is a transfer of data abroad. Localisation is therefore the single policy on this ledger with the most instruments now resting on it and the least documentation of its own.

summary: A [national public-data governance framework was gazetted on 30 December 2025](2025-12-30-joradp-decret-25-320-gouvernance-donnees) in twenty articles.
developments:
The framework did not exist at the window's opening. Presidential Decree 25-320 was [gazetted in twenty articles, its article 15 giving the data-protection authority a supervisory hook and article 18 excluding defence, security and judicial data](2025-12-30-joradp-decret-25-320-gouvernance-donnees), and was [reported as a launch in February 2026](2026-02-09-algeria-data-governance-launch-maghrebinfo).

Its article 19 classification and cataloguing duties are [not shown to have commenced](2026-02-10 Algeria launches national public-data governance framework (Decree 25-350)). A framework in force whose classification work has not started, and whose interoperability obligations wait on two reference documents that cannot be traced, is a legal position rather than an operating one.

summary: [No open-data instrument or portal is held](2026-02-09-algeria-data-governance-launch-maghrebinfo); the data-governance decree keeps public data inside institutions.
developments:
The position is unchanged at both ends of the window: [no open-data policy or portal exists, the data-governance decree keeps public data inside institutions, and a named expert criticises it for omitting open data and valorisation](2026-02-09-algeria-data-governance-launch-maghrebinfo).

It is a cited absence rather than an unexamined one, and it is a design choice rather than an oversight: the decree that governs public data was gazetted inside the window and is built around exchange between administrations on a network kept physically separate from the internet, not around publication.

summary: [Law 18-07 stands as amended, its officer and breach-notification duties added by the 2025 amendment](2026-01-11 The Year of the Teeth Data Protection in Africa Roundup, 2025, Projections for 2026).
developments:
The law was [enacted in 2018 and in force from August 2023](2024-09-19 Algeria Digital Economy (US Country Commercial Guide)), and the [2025 amendment added data-protection-officer and breach-notification duties](2026-01-11 The Year of the Teeth Data Protection in Africa Roundup, 2025, Projections for 2026).

Nothing amended it further in the window. What moved is enforcement practice rather than the statute: the authority ran a compliance push on officers, processing registers and audit logs, and issued a deliberation treating images as personal data - both under a law whose own text the base does not hold.

summary: A [digital-identity and trust-services law has been before the Assembly since 2 November 2025](2025-11-05 Algeria approves draft law on national digital ID and trust services); no promulgation is held.
developments:
The law did not exist at the window's opening. It was [approved by the Council of Ministers on 2 November 2025 and is before the National Assembly](2025-11-05 Algeria approves draft law on national digital ID and trust services), [reported in the biometrics press](2025-11-10-digital-id-trust-services-draft-law--biometricupdate), [in the state daily](2025-12-01-projet-loi-services-confiance-numeriques-apn-elmoudjahid) and [as a digital-trust and electronic-transactions measure](2025-11-04-digital-trust-e-transactions-law--wearetech). No promulgation or gazette reference is held as at 2026-08-03.

Meanwhile a unified national digital identity is already issued and in use as a single credential across the government services portal, so the credential is running nine months ahead of the statute that would govern it.

summary: An [ethical-artificial-intelligence law is reported in preparation](2025-11-10-ai-ethics-legislation-in-preparation-echorouk), with no draft text, sponsor or timetable held.
developments:
Nothing existed at the window's opening. The law is [described as in preparation, with no draft text, sponsor or timetable held](2025-11-10-ai-ethics-legislation-in-preparation-echorouk) as at 2026-08-03.

That is nine months of a stated preparation with nothing published, against a national strategy whose deployment roadmap was agreed in the same period and a university assistant announced to steer module allocation and mark student answers from the 2026-2027 academic year. No rule, appeal route or disclosure duty governs any of it.

summary: [Law 18-05 is in force while most online selling runs through social-media pages outside its obligations](2026-08-04-algerie-commerce-electronique-cadre-reglementaire), cash on delivery dominant.
developments:
The law is [in force, and the great majority of online selling runs through social-media pages outside its obligations, with cash on delivery dominant](2026-08-04-algerie-commerce-electronique-cadre-reglementaire).

The assessment is named-analyst opinion from a consumer organisation rather than a state position; the law's own date and text are not held, and no enforcement action or compliance figure is on file. A statute whose scope most of the activity it governs sits outside, with no published enforcement, is the position - and the payment side matches it, with fewer than a tenth of merchants operating a card terminal.

progress: Advanced, in activity rather than in enforcement
summary: The authority [ruled that images are personal data](2026-07-15-anpdp-algeria-deliberation-04-images-plateformes-numeriques) and ran a compliance push; [no enforcement decision is held](2025-12-01-anpdp-data-conservation-law-compliance-elmoudjahid).
developments:
The authority was operating with no enforcement decision held at the window's opening, and ran a [compliance push on officers, processing registers and audit logs from December 2025](2025-12-01-anpdp-data-conservation-law-compliance-elmoudjahid), [alongside the national police on digital-space data protection](2026-07-01-dgsn-digital-space-data-protection-elmoudjahid) and [under continental review](2026-06-23 Bimonthly Update on Privacy in Africa (January & February 2026)). Still no enforcement decision or penalty is held.

2026-07-15 - [deliberation no. 04 treats images as personal data; its article 6 holds that publishing images via platforms hosted, storing or processing data, or reachable, from outside the country is a transfer of data outside national territory, and its article 11 provides that it takes effect on publication on the Authority's own website with no gazette step](2026-07-15-anpdp-algeria-deliberation-04-images-plateformes-numeriques), [twelve members being named](2026-07-20-algerie-anpdp-regles-publication-images-plateformes).

summary: [Presidential Decree 26-07 requires security and data-protection structures in every public body](2026-01-18-algerie-jo-04-decret-presidentiel-26-07-securite-systemes-information), gazetted on 18 January 2026.
developments:
No such requirement was on record at the window's opening. The decree was [signed on 7 January 2026 and gazetted on 18 January](2026-01-18-algerie-jo-04-decret-presidentiel-26-07-securite-systemes-information), [reported as mandating security and data-protection structures in every public body](2026-01-23-decree-26-07-cybersecurity-data-protection-structures-echorouk).

Commencement is not established from the summary and the operative text is not held, so what a public body must actually stand up, by when, and to whom it answers is not checkable from anything on file. No count of bodies compliant, and no supervisory report, has followed it.

summary: Algiers [hosted two ministerial declarations](2026-03-30-algiers-declaration-telecom-sovereignty--techreviewafrica) and the country [joined a digital public infrastructure campaign](2026-03-30-algeria-joins-50in5--techreviewafrica) and a world artificial-intelligence body.
developments:
2025-12-07 - African information and communication technology ministers [adopted a declaration on fair, safe and responsible digital platforms, drafted under the African Telecommunications Union and setting founding principles for a common continental framework on over-the-top platforms, including coordinated negotiation with the global platforms and platform contribution to local infrastructure](2025-12-07-aps-declaration-alger-plateformes-ott-afrique); [continental political adoption was expected in early 2026 and nothing establishes it](2025-12-11-agence-ecofin-declaration-alger-regulation-commune-ott).

2026-03-30 - a [second Algiers declaration on telecommunications sovereignty and integrated connectivity for 2026-2030 was adopted](2026-03-30-algiers-declaration-telecom-sovereignty--techreviewafrica), and the country [joined a digital public infrastructure campaign as its fifteenth African member](2026-03-30-algeria-joins-50in5--techreviewafrica), [confirmed in the state press](2026-04-02-algeria-joins-50-in-5-campaign-echorouk) and [in the biometrics press](2026-04-27-algeria-joins-50-in-5-dpi-campaign--biometricupdate).

2026-07-16 - a [founding signature at a world artificial-intelligence organisation is reported with no accord text, ratification step or work programme on file](2026-08-01-care-algeria-digital-brief-001-apres-les-annonces-lepreuve-de-lexecution).

summary: [eSIM adoption is under way across the operators](2025-10-15-esim-integration-move--techafricanews), and a [national accreditation and conformity network was announced](2026-07-23-echorouk-conseil-gouvernement-telecoms-medias-numeriques).
developments:
No eSIM offer was on record at the window's opening; [adoption has been under way across the operators since October 2025](2025-10-15-esim-integration-move--techafricanews), with no subscriber figure, tariff or launch date published for any operator since.

2026-07-23 - a [national accreditation and conformity network and its testing platform were announced at the Council of Government](2026-07-23-echorouk-conseil-gouvernement-telecoms-medias-numeriques), with no instrument, scope or commencement stated. Both are announcements of intent to conform rather than conformity achieved, and neither has a published standard behind it.

progress: No change, two draft instruments extending state control over platforms and information verification are before the legislature and the Council of Government, neither adopted
summary: A [platform-regulation bill is under examination](2025-10-30-wearetech-algerie-regulation-plateformes-numeriques) and a [national information-verification system is in draft](2026-07-23-echorouk-conseil-gouvernement-telecoms-medias-numeriques); neither is adopted.
developments:
2025-10-30 - a private member's bill was [deposited at the National Assembly and reported under examination: it would bind platforms above one million users in the country to a local office, a legal representative, in-country data storage, takedown within twenty-four hours and six-monthly compliance reports, and would create a regulator attached to the Presidency](2025-10-30-wearetech-algerie-regulation-plateformes-numeriques). The provisions are the outlet's reading, the bill text is not held, and nothing on file establishes adoption.

2026-07-23 - a [national information-verification system was examined in draft by the Council of Government, with no regulator, legal basis or oversight mechanism named in anything held](2026-07-23-echorouk-conseil-gouvernement-telecoms-medias-numeriques).

Both would bear directly on what may be published and by whom, and neither has a text on file.

summary: Three cooperation tracks opened in the window: [Tunisia and Niger](2026-06-09-algeria-tunisia-telecom-ict-cooperation--techafricanews), [Oman](2026-07-26-echorouk-algerie-oman-transformation-numerique) and an [investor-matching partnership](2026-08-20-afrilabs-eyconet-north-africa-investors).
developments:
2026-06 - a [fourth joint technical commission with Tunisia met](2026-06-09-algeria-tunisia-telecom-ict-cooperation--techafricanews), following [telecommunications cooperation with Niger in March 2026](2026-03-30-algeria-niger-telecom-cooperation--techreviewafrica); no instrument text or value is held for either.

2026-07-26 - an [Omani ministry and sovereign investment authority offered flexible partnerships across artificial intelligence, data centres, financial technology and space, with nothing concluded at the meeting](2026-07-26-echorouk-algerie-oman-transformation-numerique).

2026-08-20 - a [continental innovation-hub network was tied to a platform connecting North African companies to investors](2026-08-20-afrilabs-eyconet-north-africa-investors); no commitment value, deal target, fee structure or first cohort is published, so what it moves is a channel rather than capital.

summary: A [US$1bn African startup financing fund was committed in October 2025](2025-10-27 Algeria commits $1bn to African Startup Financing Fund) with no disbursement held; the state fund [recorded its first exit](2025-12-16-volz-raises-5-million--techcabal).
developments:
The fund was launched in September 2025 and [US$1bn was committed on 21 October 2025, with no disbursement held](2025-10-27 Algeria commits $1bn to African Startup Financing Fund).

Domestically the state venture arm reported [1,600 microenterprises, 130 startups and 2,800 registered patents by mid-2025 against a target of 20,000 startups by 2029](2025-10-27 Algeria commits $1bn to African Startup Financing Fund), and its [first fund exit came in December 2025, with domestic startups raising US$5.3m across two rounds in 2025](2025-12-16-volz-raises-5-million--techcabal).

The scale gap is the finding: a billion dollars committed to a continental fund with no disbursement on file, against five million raised domestically in the same year.

summary: A [UN development programme's support was extended with Japanese funding in May 2026](2026-05-05-undp-japan-digital-transformation-project-echorouk) on a 2027-2030 executive plan.
developments:
Support was [planned in November 2025](2025-11-03-undp-support-digital-transformation--wearetech) and [agreed the following day in reporting](2025-11-04-undp-agreement-digital-transformation--techafricanews).

2026-05-05 - it was [extended with Japanese funding, on a 2027-2030 executive plan supporting the high commission's strategy, with no budget figure held](2026-05-05-undp-japan-digital-transformation-project-echorouk).

It is the only development-partner digital financing on this ledger. No lender project, credit or grant for digital infrastructure appears anywhere else, which for a country of this size is itself the finding: the programmes here are domestically financed and their budget lines are not published.

summary: [Three 5G licences were awarded in December 2025 for DZD 63.9bn](2025-12-08-mobilis-djezzy-ooredoo-492m-5g-rollout--itweb), and one operator is live in all wilayas.
developments:
A [tender was launched in mid-2025](2025-05-29-arpce-launches-5g-licence-tender-echorouk) with no award, [reported across the trade press](2025-06-02-5g-licence-tender-launch--connectingafrica), and [one operator secured its licence in July](2025-07-04-ooredoo-secures-5g-licence--telecomreviewafrica). 2025-12-08 - [three licences were awarded for DZD 63.9bn, about US$492m, on a six-year plan to nationwide coverage by 2031](2025-12-08-mobilis-djezzy-ooredoo-492m-5g-rollout--itweb), the [rollout beginning that month](2025-12-05-algeria-launches-5g-rollout--connectingafrica). By March 2026 [one operator was live in all wilayas](2026-03-12-ooredoo-5g-all-provinces--connectingafrica) and [another in eighteen](2026-03-04-djezzy-nationwide-5g-18-states--techafricanews).

2026-02-18 - [345 new 4G base stations were announced across 44 wilayas, toward 4,500 localities by 2027](2026-02-18 Algeria Telecom plans 345 new 4G stations nationwide). [Draft decrees renewing two GSM licences were examined by the Council of Government in July 2026 with no term, fee or coverage obligation published](2026-07-23-echorouk-conseil-gouvernement-telecoms-medias-numeriques).

Market entry below licence level is inert: the regulator had [registered two authorisations for private cabled networks by the end of 2024 and received no applications at all under the simple-declaration regime, operators on general authorisations generating 1.28% of sector revenue](2026-01-07-arpce-algeria-annual-report-2024).

summary: The regulator's 2024 report records [fixed internet at 6,216,146 subscribers, up 12.48% on 619,779 new fibre connections](2026-01-07-arpce-algeria-annual-report-2024).
developments:
The [2024 annual report records 60.98m combined fixed and mobile subscribers at 31 December 2024, of which 54.05m mobile and 6.93m fixed, with 47.30m of the mobile base on 4G against 2.73m on second-generation service, that older base down by a fifth in the year; fixed internet stands at 6,216,146, up 12.48% on 619,779 new fibre connections](2026-01-07-arpce-algeria-annual-report-2024).

It is the only official statistical release held: no quarterly observatory, statistics-office series or payment-instrument report exists. 2026-07-14 - [generalisation of the newer internet addressing standard was ordered, with no completion date](2026-07-14-ipv6-adoption-echorouk).

summary: [3.4m of over 7m fixed-internet subscribers are on fibre](2026-05-16-zerrouki-fibre-optic-completion-2027-echorouk), with copper replacement targeted for end-2026 or early 2027.
developments:
The [copper phase-out was announced in May 2025 on a 2027 target](2025-05-02-copper-phase-out-fiber-2027--wearetech). By May 2026 there were [over 7m fixed-internet subscribers of which over 3.4m on fibre, and over 51m mobile subscribers, with copper replacement targeted for end-2026 or early 2027](2026-05-16-zerrouki-fibre-optic-completion-2027-echorouk), after [3m fibre-to-the-home households in February](2026-02-20-three-million-households-fibre-broadband--techafricanews) and a [claim of continental leadership on that measure](2026-02-17-algeria-first-africa-ftth-connectivity-echorouk).

The [400G optical backbone was commissioned in February 2025 and no capacity update has followed](2025-02-25-algerie-telecom-huawei-400g--techafricanews), and an [Italy-Algeria submarine cable is at memorandum stage only, with no build contract, route or landing date](2025-07-25-algerie-telecom-sparkle-subsea-cable--connectingafrica).

summary: An independent measurement puts [local content at 13% of national traffic, most of it served from European servers](2026-06-09 Beyond the Homepage Measuring What It Really Takes to Keep Web Traffic Local).
developments:
The position is unchanged at both ends: an [independent measurement puts local content at 13% of national traffic in June 2026, most of it served from European servers, with no national exchange point or local-hosting policy held](2026-06-09 Beyond the Homepage Measuring What It Really Takes to Keep Web Traffic Local).

It is the only traffic-localisation measure on this ledger and it is a third party's. A country with mandatory in-country data localisation, a new national data centre and a sovereign cloud has no published exchange point, and most of what its users reach is served from another continent.

summary: The regulator [opened a tender for two satellite-internet licences in April 2026](2026-04-09-satellite-communications-competition-two-licences-echorouk); no award is held.
developments:
There was no licensing route for non-geostationary satellite service at the window's opening. 2026-04-09 - the regulator [opened a tender for two licences](2026-04-09-satellite-communications-competition-two-licences-echorouk), [reported as opening the satellite communications market](2026-04-09-satellite-communications-market-tender--techreviewafrica).

No award is held as at 2026-08-03, four months on. Nothing on file states the licence terms, the spectrum on offer, the coverage obligation or the closing date, so what the two licences would oblige a winner to do is unknown.

summary: The [research cloud platform and its incubator are live](2025-03-26-cerist-cloud-drone-incubator--wearetech), unchanged since March 2025.
developments:
The platform was [launched in March 2025 on open-source cloud and container technology, with an incubator attached targeting 100 startups a year from 2027](2025-03-26-cerist-cloud-drone-incubator--wearetech), and nothing revises it.

No capacity, tenancy or utilisation figure is published for it or for any commercial facility in the country. Against mandatory data localisation and no hyperscaler presence, the base holds one research cloud, one state centre and one construction site - and no measure of what any of them holds.

summary: A [national digital services centre on two active-active sites was inaugurated on 5 July 2026](2026-07-05-national-centre-digital-services-inauguration-echorouk), carrying the sovereign cloud.
developments:
Neither existed at the window's opening. 2026-07-05 - the centre was [inaugurated across two active-active sites](2026-07-05-national-centre-digital-services-inauguration-echorouk), [built to a Tier III design with 99.98% availability claimed by the operator](2026-07-08-national-digital-services-center-dual-data-centers--wearetech), [reported by the state daily](2026-07-06-national-digital-services-centre-inaugurated-elmoudjahid) and [in the national press](2026-07-05-jeune-independant-centre-national-services-numeriques); [administrations were ordered to interconnect within one month from 12 July](2026-07-15-one-month-deadline-data-center-integration--wearetech).

The [sovereign cloud is live on it with no service catalogue or tenant list held](2026-06-04-parliament-sovereign-cloud-agreement-echorouk). An [artificial-intelligence supercomputing and data centre at Oran broke ground in March 2025 and remains under construction with no commissioning date or capacity figure](2025-03-17-ai-supercomputing-center-oran--wearetech).

summary: A [2025-2029 security strategy was presented in March 2026](2026-03-03-defence-information-systems-security-strategy-2029-echorouk) and a [sectoral incident-response centre established](2026-06-15-mpt-cert-cyber-incident-response-centre-echorouk).
developments:
An information systems security agency [operates under the Ministry of National Defence with no establishing instrument held](2026-01-26-cybersecurity-framework-national-infrastructure--techafricanews), its first attested act in March 2026. 2026-03-03 - it [presented a 2025-2029 national strategy approved by the President, the text not held](2026-03-03-defence-information-systems-security-strategy-2029-echorouk), [reported in the trade press](2026-03-05-national-cybersecurity-strategy-2025-2029--wearetech).

2026-06-15 - a [sectoral incident-response centre for posts and telecommunications was established with Korean technical support](2026-06-15-mpt-cert-cyber-incident-response-centre-echorouk), [reported the same day](2026-06-15-mpt-cert-cyber-incident-response--techafricanews); a [child online-protection cell and green line opened on 1 June](2026-06-01-child-online-protection-cyber-vigilance-cell-echorouk); and a [cybersecurity memorandum with a Russian vendor was signed in November 2025 with no implementing project held](2025-11-01-algeria-russia-cybersecurity-mou-elmoudjahid).

2026-08-18 - a [wilaya warned that unlicensed platforms are impersonating its institutions as fake ticketing storefronts built to harvest card details](2026-08-18-algerie360-alger-fake-portals-alert), with no takedown or prosecution published.

summary: The President [gave a one-month deadline on 12 July 2026 for cross-sector interconnection through the national data centre](2026-08-10-algeria-care-digital-brief-interconnection); no completion is reported.
developments:
The interoperability system is [created by article 10 of the data-governance decree as the exclusive channel for inter-agency data exchange, on a network kept physically separate from the internet, its obligations starting only when the two reference documents required by article 8 are published](2025-12-30-joradp-decret-25-320-gouvernance-donnees). Those were [not traced as at 20 July 2026](2026-02-09-algeria-data-governance-launch-maghrebinfo).

2026-07-12 - the President [gave a one-month deadline for cross-sector interconnection through the national data centre, and no completion has been reported against it](2026-08-10-algeria-care-digital-brief-interconnection), the [decree being presented as the technical base for it](2026-01-01-decree-25-320-data-governance-technical-base-elmoudjahid).

A deadline set against obligations that have not commenced is the position: the instrument exists, the reference documents that would start it do not.

summary: A [unified national digital identity is issued and in use as a single credential across the government services portal](2026-08-12-algeria-sports-platforms-unified-digital-identity).
developments:
The credential was not on record at the window's opening. It is [issued by the high commission for digitalisation and in use as a single credential across the national services portal; on 12 August 2026 the sports ministry integrated its own platforms into that portal so that holders reach them without separate registration](2026-08-12-algeria-sports-platforms-unified-digital-identity).

No enrolment count, assurance level, governing instrument or data-protection basis for the credential is held. It is running ahead of the digital-identity and trust-services law that has sat before the Assembly since November 2025, so what it legally is, and what a holder may refuse, is not established anywhere on file.

summary: The police [signed a biometrics and digital-forensics memorandum with a foreign interior ministry in November 2025](2025-11-21-dgsn-uk-digital-forensics-biometrics-mou--biometricupdate).
developments:
Nothing of the kind was on record at the window's opening. 2025-11-21 - a memorandum was [signed covering fingerprint-analysis training and biometric identity-verification exchange](2025-11-21-dgsn-uk-digital-forensics-biometrics-mou--biometricupdate).

No value, duration, workplan or data-handling arrangement is stated for it. Biometric identity-verification exchange between two states' police forces, in a country whose data-protection authority has issued no enforcement decision and whose deliberations take effect on its own website, has no published safeguard attached.

summary: The [certification and governmental signature authorities were designated in 2025](2025-09-01-arpce-service-authentification-signature-electroniques-elmoudjahid), modernising the 2015 framework.
developments:
Both authorities were [designated by February 2025](2025-02-17-electronic-signatures-certification--wearetech) and the regulator's [authentication and electronic-signature service was set out in September 2025](2025-09-01-arpce-service-authentification-signature-electroniques-elmoudjahid), modernising the 2015 electronic-signature framework.

Nothing moved after that. No certificate count, relying-party list or usage figure is published, and the trust-services law that would put the arrangement on a current statutory footing is still before the Assembly - so the country's signature layer runs on a 2015 framework with two designations on top of it.

summary: [Remote biometric passport renewal opened to the diaspora on 24 June 2026](2026-06-24-remote-biometric-passport-renewal-diaspora-echorouk).
developments:
The service did not exist at the window's opening. 2026-06-24 - [remote renewal opened to consular applicants](2026-06-24-remote-biometric-passport-renewal-diaspora-echorouk).

No application count, processing time or issuance figure has been published since. It is the clearest use of the identity layer by a service that is not itself an identity service, and it reaches a population outside the country - which makes the absence of any stated data-transfer basis, in a state with mandatory in-country localisation, the open question the record does not address.

summary: A [national payments committee was given its composition and working arrangements by regulation on 31 May 2026](2026-08-04-algerie-comite-national-paiement-fin-domination-cash).
developments:
The committee was created by the 2023 monetary and banking law with no operating framework published. A [regulation of 31 May 2026 set its composition and working arrangements: an advisory body seated at the central bank, chaired by the Governor, seating seven ministries, the postal operator, the interbank card and electronic-money bodies, the banking association, two appointed experts and the internal security, gendarmerie and police directorates, owing government a published annual report on payment instruments and periodic statistics](2026-08-04-algerie-comite-national-paiement-fin-domination-cash). The national payments strategy is not drafted and no annual report is published; the regulation text is not held.

[Digital-bank licensing was established and a binding know-your-customer instruction issued on 30 April 2026](2026-04-29-kyc-bank-of-algeria-new-instruction-elmoudjahid), [binding on banks for anti-money-laundering and politically-exposed-person scrutiny](2026-05-04-kyc-instruction-04-2026-financial-audit-echorouk). A [digital currency is argued for in the press with no central-bank instrument, pilot, design or timetable on file](2026-04-27-digital-dinar-blockchain-financial-sovereignty-echorouk).

summary: Electronic tax payment is now [mandatory for large enterprises and optional for others](2026-08-05-algeria-dgi-jibayatic-electronic-tax-payment-guide), with a first user guide published in August 2026.
developments:
Tax data was [integrated across the assessment and contribution platforms in March 2025](2025-03-11-digital-tax-data-integration--wearetech).

2026-08-05 - the tax directorate published its first user guide for electronic payment: it is [mandatory for taxpayers under the large-enterprise directorate and optional for others, covering only tax and duties from electronic declarations rather than existing debts; payment by transfer or card generates a verifiable electronic receipt, and a rejected transaction cannot be retried electronically, the taxpayer having to attend a local office instead](2026-08-05-algeria-dgi-jibayatic-electronic-tax-payment-guide). The guide lists seventeen rejection reasons, and no volume or adoption figure is published.

The [fiscal stamp-duty payment platform has been live since August 2024](2024-08-11 Algeria launches Tabioucom fiscal-stamp-duty e-payment platform) and [carries commercial registration duties](2026-01-05-digital-stamp-duty-commercial-registration--techafricanews).

summary: The [domestic instant payment system announced in October 2024 has no launch date held](2024-10-14 Algeria to launch domestic instant payment system (Bank of Algeria)), and a QR wallet is unconfirmed.
developments:
The instant payment system was [announced in October 2024 to replace settlement of up to seventy-two hours, and no launch date is held as at 2026-08-03](2024-10-14 Algeria to launch domestic instant payment system (Bank of Algeria)).

A [mobile QR payment service was announced for a January 2025 launch by a state bank, an Islamic bank and the postal operator, and nothing held confirms it went live](2024-01-01 Algeria to launch DZ MOB PAY mobile payment system); the source is year-precision.

So the country's card estate grew by millions of cards and hundreds of billions of dinars in the window while both of its account-to-account retail rails stayed announcements.

summary: [Over 22m cards and 104,000 terminals were in issue at end-March 2026](2026-05-16-electronic-payment-market-22-million-cards--wearetech), with payments up 46% in 2025.
developments:
Fewer than a tenth of merchants operated a terminal at the window's opening. At end-March 2026 there were [over 22m cards including nearly 18m of the postal operator's, over 104,000 terminals and 4,713 cash machines](2026-05-16-electronic-payment-market-22-million-cards--wearetech), with [electronic payments of DZD 939bn in 2025, up 46% year on year, and fewer than a tenth of merchants still operating a terminal](2026-05-15-electronic-payment-latest-figures-echorouk).

2026-06-30 - [more than 1,000 web merchants were connected, passing that threshold, alongside reported growth in online and mobile payment and in acceptance at physical shops over the first half of 2026](2026-08-22-alger16-h1-2026-epayment-indicators). The half-year indicators are reported in narrative form without a published series.

summary: The central bank [joined the pan-African settlement network as its eighteenth member on 15 August 2025](2025-08-15 Bank of Algeria joins PAPSS network); no transaction volume is held.
developments:
Membership did not exist at the window's opening. 2025-08-15 - the central bank [joined as the eighteenth country, with no transaction volume held](2025-08-15 Bank of Algeria joins PAPSS network).

No Algerian bank is named as live on the rail, no corridor volume or value is published, and nothing states the settlement or pricing arrangement a domestic institution would face. It is an accession rather than a working corridor, and it sits in a market whose own domestic instant rail has not launched.

summary: The electronic commercial register recorded [173,651 new registrations against 125,195 struck off in 2025](2026-03-29-electronic-commercial-registry-statistics-echorouk), and trade platforms went live.
developments:
The register recorded [173,651 new registrations against 125,195 struck-off registrations in 2025](2026-03-29-electronic-commercial-registry-statistics-echorouk), with [business registration and stamp duties moved online in December 2025](2025-12-27-business-registration-stamp-duties-online--wearetech).

2026-03-18 - a [national export-data platform went live](2026-03-18-national-export-data-platform--wearetech), [reported in French the same day](2026-03-18-fichier-numerique-national-exportations--wearetech-fr), followed on 24 March by a [national import-tracking system](2026-03-24-import-tracking-system--wearetech).

2026-08-01 - a [services-import platform entered operation as the exclusive route for services-import applications, covering software and licences, cloud services, maintenance and engineering, consultancy and training](2026-07-27-echorouk-plateforme-numerique-import-services), with [no fallback or assisted channel stated](2026-08-01-care-algeria-digital-brief-001-apres-les-annonces-lepreuve-de-lexecution).

summary: An [electronic land-title system went nationwide on 13 January 2026](2026-01-12-electronic-land-titles-amlak--wearetech), with end-to-end traceability.
developments:
The system did not exist at the window's opening. 2026-01 - it [went nationwide with end-to-end traceability, and no coverage figure is published](2026-01-12-electronic-land-titles-amlak--wearetech).

No count of titles issued, parcels covered or transactions processed has followed. It is one of six registers or platforms this country put into service inside the window, all announced as live and none accompanied by a volume figure - which is the shape of the whole govtech position here.

summary: A [patient-transfer platform went live in December 2025](2025-12-01-health-patient-transfer-digital-platform-elmoudjahid), prioritising the South and the Highlands.
developments:
The platform did not exist at the window's opening. 2025-12 - it [went live, prioritising the South and the Highlands](2025-12-01-health-patient-transfer-digital-platform-elmoudjahid).

No transfer volume, waiting time or coverage figure has been published since. It is the only clinical system on this ledger; no health information system, patient record or facility register appears anywhere else, so a transfer-routing platform is the whole of the health digital position.

summary: [Four higher-education platforms went live in February 2026](2026-02-25-four-digital-platforms-higher-education--techafricanews), and a [national qualifications framework entered pilot](2026-06-19-national-qualifications-framework-cnc--wearetech).
developments:
2026-02-24 - [four digital platforms for university services went live](2026-02-25-four-digital-platforms-higher-education--techafricanews), [reported in French the same day](2026-02-25-quatre-plateformes-numeriques-services-universitaires--wearetech-fr). No user, registration or service-volume figure has followed.

2026-06-19 - a [national certification and qualifications framework entered pilot](2026-06-19-national-qualifications-framework-cnc--wearetech), with no scope, participant count or completion date stated.

Against these, an artificial-intelligence assistant is announced for the 2026-2027 academic year to steer module allocation and mark student answers, with no appeal route or human-review threshold published anywhere.

summary: The labour ministry [reports 235 social-security services delivered online](2026-07-24-algerie360-saihi-portail-unique-securite-sociale-numerisation), and an [electronic health card is issuing to the uninsured](2026-01-21-cnas-electronic-health-card-uninsured-echorouk).
developments:
2026-07 - the ministry [reports 235 services delivered online and 97% document digitisation as at April 2026, against a target of half as many procedures again online by December 2026, with no interoperability with the national portal stated](2026-07-24-algerie360-saihi-portail-unique-securite-sociale-numerisation). The figures are the ministry's own.

2026-01-21 - an [electronic health card began issuing to the uninsured under a 2024 decree](2026-01-21-cnas-electronic-health-card-uninsured-echorouk); no issuance figure is published.

2026-06 - [social cartography was tasked to the high commission for placement on the national services portal, with no delivery date stated](2026-06-01-social-cartography-national-services-portal-elmoudjahid).

summary: A [lawyers' portal issuing certified court decisions online went live on 16 February 2026](2026-02-16-online-system-lawyers-certified-court-decisions--wearetech).
developments:
The portal did not exist at the window's opening. 2026-02-16 - [certified court decisions began to be issued to lawyers online](2026-02-16-online-system-lawyers-certified-court-decisions--wearetech).

No issuance volume, court coverage or processing-time figure has been published since. A [notaries' e-services memorandum signed with the incumbent operator in July 2025 has produced no service reported live](2025-07-15-algerie-telecom-notaries-mou--techafricanews), so the justice-sector position is one live service for one profession and a memorandum for another.

summary: Customs [began a phased rollout of a unified electronic window under a circular of 13 August 2026](2026-08-19-echorouk-algeria-paperless-import-export-licences), before paper is withdrawn.
developments:
The window did not exist at the window's opening. 2026-08-13 - the customs administration [began the phased rollout of a unified electronic window inside its customs information system, requiring importers and clearing agents to file the trade ministry's administrative licences and certificates electronically in parallel with the existing paper route during a transition, before paper is withdrawn entirely](2026-08-19-echorouk-algeria-paperless-import-export-licences).

The transition period is of unstated length. No volume, participant count or withdrawal date for the paper route is published, so what the rollout has reached and when the parallel route ends are both unstated.

summary: The national portal [took vocational-training intake registrations in August 2026](2026-08-23-echorouk-algeria-takwin-service-national-digital-services-portal), while the interior minister [named ministry projects as stalled](2026-08-10-algeria-sayoud-digitisation-acceleration-interior).
developments:
The interior minister convened wilaya regulation directors to evaluate the national vehicle-registration information system ([evaluation](2026-08-26-algeria-vehicle-registration-system-evaluation)). What the evaluation found is not stated.

The portal was [launched as a single window in October 2025](2025-10-17 Algeria launches Dzair Services single-window public-services platform) alongside an older portal carrying 342 services whose relationship to it is not stated. It had [21 services live at July 2026 with a free helpline from 29 July](2026-07-29-elhiwar-hcn-green-number-3017-dzair-digital-services) and [six energy services added on 20 August](2026-08-21-algerie-eco-hcn-six-energy-digital-services). 2026-08-23 - a [sector service was placed on it for the first time, with 82,383 candidates registered by 23 August and the portal's interoperability layer handling identity and personal-data verification](2026-08-23-echorouk-algeria-takwin-service-national-digital-services-portal).

Against that, 2026-08-10 - the interior minister [named all-digital vehicle registration and civil-status services among ministry projects that have stalled and are to be accelerated](2026-08-10-algeria-sayoud-digitisation-acceleration-interior), without saying in what respect or giving a revised timetable; the press [describes citizens still attending in person for procedures presented as online](2026-08-11-algeria-digitisation-dysfunctions-persist-critique) and an [inspection of one biometric-documents office after complaints of overnight queues and a daily cap on files](2026-08-11-algeria-biometric-document-office-queues-ouled-fayet).

2026-07-09 - an [apostille legalisation platform went live following accession to the Hague Convention in August 2025, with recognition claimed in about 126 states](2026-07-10-apostille-platform-launch-echorouk).

summary: The [only account of municipal digitalisation on file is an academic one from 2025](2025-01-01 e-Municipalities in Algeria within the e-Government Strategy (Billeh)).
developments:
Municipal digitalisation is [in development on a year-precision academic account, and no later account is held](2025-01-01 e-Municipalities in Algeria within the e-Government Strategy (Billeh)).

Nothing moved at either end of the window. In a country that inaugurated a national data centre, launched a sovereign cloud, ordered every administration to interconnect within a month and put a national services portal into operation, the base holds not one statement by any authority about what a commune can do online.

summary: An [artificial-intelligence learning-pathway assistant and marking model is announced for the 2026-2027 academic year](2026-07-25-echorouk-parcours-pedagogique-ia-universite).
developments:
Nothing of the kind existed at the window's opening. It is [announced for the 2026-2027 academic year, steering module allocation and marking student answers, with no appeal route, accuracy claim, disclosure duty or human-review threshold reported](2026-07-25-echorouk-parcours-pedagogique-ia-universite).

It is the first use of automated decision-making on individuals the base records for this country, and it lands in the same year an ethical-artificial-intelligence law was reported in preparation with no draft text. A student marked by a model would have, on the evidence held, no published route to contest it.

A second sectoral use is operational rather than announced: the forestry and civil protection directorates built artificial-intelligence-assisted prediction and early warning into the 2026 fire campaign, with thermal-camera drones flying day and night, on a detector the state research centre first produced in 2023 ([campaign](2026-08-30-algerie-ia-detection-incendies-forets)).

summary: An [operator launched a sovereign artificial-intelligence cloud in April 2026](2026-04-30-djezzy-aventurecloudz-ai-platform--techafricanews), and a [virtual-education innovation centre opened](2026-06-08-first-virtual-education-ai-innovation-centre-echorouk).
developments:
2026-04-30 - a mobile operator [launched a sovereign artificial-intelligence cloud platform](2026-04-30-djezzy-aventurecloudz-ai-platform--techafricanews); no capacity, tenant or service figure has followed.

2026-06-08 - a [virtual-education artificial-intelligence innovation centre opened and is operating](2026-06-08-first-virtual-education-ai-innovation-centre-echorouk), with no intake, output or budget stated.

2026-04-15 - [talks with a vendor on artificial intelligence, graphics processing and the digital economy were reported, with no agreement, instrument or value stated](2026-04-15-algeria-huawei-ai-digital-economy-cooperation-echorouk). The national strategy's own priority of sovereign open-source government models and national high-performance computing has no compute figure attached anywhere on file.

summary: The state electronics firm was [accredited to install and maintain all payment terminals nationwide](2026-07-31-algerie-enie-agrement-gie-monetique-paiement-electronique), having produced 1.6m of them.
developments:
2026-05 - the firm reported [1.6m payment terminals produced](2026-05-25-eni-produces-1-6-million-tpe-echorouk).

2026-07-31 - an [interbank accreditation widened it from its own-brand devices to installing and maintaining every terminal on national territory whatever its brand or origin](2026-07-31-algerie-enie-agrement-gie-monetique-paiement-electronique); the accreditation's own date is not stated, only the report of it.

2025-09-16 - a [national technology hub agreement was signed by the sovereign fund with an operator and three technology firms, with no capitalisation, timetable or launch held](2025-09-19-fni-tech-hub-public-sector--wearetech).

summary: An [artificial-intelligence and cybersecurity startup cluster opened at Sidi Abdellah on 18 April 2026](2026-04-20-first-ai-cybersecurity-startup-cluster--wearetech).
developments:
The cluster did not exist at the window's opening. 2026-04-18 - it [opened and is operating, inside a target of 20,000 startups by 2029](2026-04-20-first-ai-cybersecurity-startup-cluster--wearetech).

No tenancy, occupancy or employment figure has been published since. It is the only physical hub on this ledger, and the target it sits inside is roughly a hundred and fifty times the 130 startups the state venture arm reported by mid-2025.

summary: A [student start-up and patent conversion scheme reports 673 start-ups and 3,949 patents](2026-08-06-strategie-nationale-de-lintelligence-artificielle-kamel-baddari-fixe-la-feuille-de-route), and [listing fees are waived to 2028](2026-02-03-waives-ipo-fees-startups-until-2028--wearetech).
developments:
2026-02-03 - [initial public offering fees were waived for startups to 2028](2026-02-03-waives-ipo-fees-startups-until-2028--wearetech), and a [structured video-game and e-sports industry plan was announced with no instrument held](2026-02-03-algeria-structured-video-game-industry--techreviewafrica).

A ministerial order letting students convert final-year projects into start-ups or patents reports [673 start-ups, 3,949 patents and 2,339 innovative-project labels between 2022 and July 2026, against a 2030 target of 5,000 labelled products, supported by a prototype-financing scheme and the country's first venture-capital fund](2026-08-06-strategie-nationale-de-lintelligence-artificielle-kamel-baddari-fixe-la-feuille-de-route). The order's own date and text are not held and the figures are a newspaper's.

summary: A [national digital empowerment programme drew 64,508 registrations across all 58 wilayas](2026-05-19-national-digital-empowerment-7-77--techreviewafrica), 30% choosing artificial intelligence.
developments:
The programme did not exist at the window's opening. By May 2026 it had [64,508 registrations across all 58 wilayas](2026-05-19-national-digital-empowerment-7-77--techreviewafrica), of which [19,691 chose artificial intelligence against 9,678 for professional cybersecurity, and 80.4% chose remote delivery](2026-05-21-national-digital-empowerment-7-77-enrolment-echorouk).

No completion or outcome figure is held. It is by an order of magnitude the largest measured participation in anything on this ledger, and what any of those registrations produced is unpublished.

summary: A [twelve-week national artificial-intelligence vocational programme began on 27 April 2026](2026-04-27-ai-vocational-training-programme--techreviewafrica), and a [second security-officer cohort ran](2026-06-01-rssi-cybersecurity-training-sidi-abdellah-elmoudjahid).
developments:
2026-04-27 - a [twelve-week artificial-intelligence vocational programme began with an incubator attached, with no cohort size held](2026-04-27-ai-vocational-training-programme--techreviewafrica).

2026-06 - a [second cohort of information-security officer training ran at Sidi Abdellah under the defence-ministry security agency](2026-06-01-rssi-cybersecurity-training-sidi-abdellah-elmoudjahid); no cohort size, curriculum or certification is published for it either.

Neither has an output figure, so against a strategy targeting half a million sector jobs by 2030 the base holds two programmes and no graduate count.

summary: A [High Council of Scientists was installed at the Presidency on 20 June 2026](2026-06-20-high-council-scientists-presidency-structures-echorouk).
developments:
The council did not exist at the window's opening. 2026-06-20 - it was [installed at the Presidency](2026-06-20-high-council-scientists-presidency-structures-echorouk).

No membership, remit, first opinion or reporting arrangement is published. It sits alongside a fifteen-member scientific and technical committee seated at the high commission for digitalisation in October 2025 and a national artificial-intelligence research and innovation strategy drawn up by 150 experts - three advisory bodies of academics in a year, none of which has published anything the base can point to.

summary: A [complaints platform for economic operators went live on 11 August 2026](2026-08-09-algeria-foreign-trade-e-platform-launch), and an [ombudsman videoconference reception is to pilot](2026-08-09-algeria-mediateur-virtual-reception-digital-transformation).
developments:
2026-08-11 - a platform went [live for remote filing and tracking of economic operators' complaints on import and export procedures, without attending ministry offices, described by the trade ministry as the fifth digital platform it put into service in 2026](2026-08-09-algeria-foreign-trade-e-platform-launch). The minister [inspected the platform offices on 15 August and ordered faster, continuously monitored processing](2026-08-15-rziq-manassat-raqmiya-algeria); no processing time, backlog figure, complaint count or service standard is published, so the instruction to go faster is not measured against anything.

2026-08-09 - the ombudsman [announced a videoconference citizen-reception service to pilot from September 2026, to ease access for citizens in remote areas and people with specific needs](2026-08-09-algeria-mediateur-virtual-reception-digital-transformation), with no site list, capacity, appointment rule or evaluation attached.

summary: A [universal-service programme reached 1,400 low-density areas in its first phase](2026-05-16-zerrouki-fibre-optic-completion-2027-echorouk), with no target, budget or completion date.
developments:
The programme's position was not held at the window's opening. By May 2026 it had [reached 1,400 areas in a first phase, with no target, budget or completion date stated, against 76.9% internet penetration and 10.9m people offline in 2025](2026-05-16-zerrouki-fibre-optic-completion-2027-echorouk).

The offline figure is a third-party compilation rather than an official series, and no rural coverage, affordability or usage-gap measure is published by the regulator or the ministry. So the country can state how many areas a programme reached and not how many people remain outside it, except on someone else's number.

summary: A [national agricultural information system went live in June 2026](2026-06-01-national-agricultural-information-system-elmoudjahid), alongside [market-supply](2026-04-27-unified-market-supply-monitoring-system-echorouk) and [enterprise](2026-05-17-sme-economic-information-system-echorouk) systems.
developments:
2026-04-27 - a [unified market-supply monitoring system went live, built under the data-governance decree](2026-04-27-unified-market-supply-monitoring-system-echorouk). 2026-05-17 - a [small and medium enterprise economic information system went live](2026-05-17-sme-economic-information-system-echorouk). 2026-06 - a [national agricultural information system brought up farm-register, agricultural-land, livestock and support-programme modules](2026-06-01-national-agricultural-information-system-elmoudjahid).

Two more are at memorandum or intention stage: an [automated water-meter reading pilot agreed in July 2026 with no site, scale or start date](2026-07-30-omantel-expands-regional-digital-footprint-with-algeria-smart-water-partnership), and [tachograph monitoring of heavy goods vehicles and coaches, presented as a shift from traditional inspection to continuous monitoring, with no implementing instrument, deadline or fleet coverage stated](2026-08-21-echorouk-algeria-tachograph-smart-monitoring-professional-transport).

Not one of the five publishes an output.

summary: [Two high-resolution Earth-observation satellites reached orbit in January 2026](2026-01-31-alsat-3b-satellite-launch-echorouk), operated with the defence ministry.
developments:
Neither existed at the window's opening. The first was launched on 15 January 2026 and the [second on 31 January, both from China, operated through the space agency with the Ministry of National Defence](2026-01-31-alsat-3b-satellite-launch-echorouk), [reported as a second launch](2026-02-03-alsat-3b-second-satellite-launch--connectingafrica).

No imagery product, tasking arrangement, distribution channel or civilian user is named for either. An Earth-observation capability operated with the defence ministry, in a country with a new agricultural information system carrying a land register, has no stated link between the two anywhere on file.

summary: The country [appears in two continental mappings of Chinese-supplied surveillance](2026-03-01 Smart City Surveillance in Africa (IDS 2026)) with no contract, vendor or site held.
developments:
The position is unchanged at both ends: the country [appears in continental mappings of Chinese-supplied smart-city and surveillance systems](2026-03-01 Smart City Surveillance in Africa (IDS 2026)) and [in a second such account](2026-04-04 Chinese surveillance rolled out in Africa ZTE, Hikvision, Huawei at the helm), with no contract, vendor, system name or deployment site held for this country.

What is dated is thinner: [founding membership of a twenty-nine-country artificial-intelligence organisation headquartered in Shanghai from 16 July 2026, with no obligation, contribution or work programme stated and no instrument of accession held](2026-08-10-algeria-care-digital-brief-interconnection).

summary: An [Italy telecommunications and postal cooperation memorandum signed in July 2025 stands](2025-07-28-algeria-italy-tech-cooperation--techreviewafrica) alongside the submarine cable project.
developments:
The memorandum was [signed on 28 July 2025 at a fifth high-level summit and is in force, with the submarine cable project sitting alongside it](2025-07-28-algeria-italy-tech-cooperation--techreviewafrica).

Nothing moved on it in the window, and the cable it sits beside remains a memorandum with no build contract, route or landing date. It is the only European instrument the base holds for this country, and no European Union programme, financing or regulatory cooperation appears anywhere on the ledger.

summary: Three strategic trans-Saharan projects were discussed at the highest level with Niger, both capitals reaffirming their commitment to realising them ([report](2026-08-28-actuniger-niamey-alger-projets-integration-africaine)).
developments: Three strategic trans-Saharan projects were discussed at the highest level with Niger, both capitals reaffirming their commitment to realising them ([report](2026-08-28-actuniger-niamey-alger-projets-integration-africaine)). No timetable or financing is stated.

summary: Oversight of the statistics office was [transferred by presidential decree](2025-11-13-joradp-jo75-decret-25-293-tutelle-ons) in November 2025; the governing statute is still the [1994 legislative decree](2025-07-01-unsd-algeria-statistical-system-quality).
developments:
The office's own presentation to an international quality workshop [names the 1994 legislative decree as the governing statistics law](2025-07-01-unsd-algeria-statistical-system-quality), with its organisation set by [a 1995 decree whose article 6 makes it responsible for the technical preparation, conduct, processing and analysis of population censuses](1995-06-03-unstats-decret-95-159-reamenagement-ons).

2025-11-10 - [a presidential decree transferred oversight of the office](2025-11-13-joradp-jo75-decret-25-293-tutelle-ons), and [a Council of Ministers sitting the same autumn took its modernisation](2025-10-06-tsa-algerie-conseil-ministres-modernisation-ons).

The institution is being rearranged around a statute that is thirty-two years old, and no replacement bill is on the record.

progress: No change, a first stated position with no earlier account behind it
summary: A [national statistics strategy for 2024 to 2028 was recalled by the statistics office](2024-11-20-radioalgerie-modernisation-systemes-ons); its text is not held.
developments:
2024-11-18 - the statistics office's director general [recalled a national statistics strategy for 2024 to 2028 at a finance ministry information day](2024-11-20-radioalgerie-modernisation-systemes-ons). That single mention is the whole of what the base holds about it.

The strategy's own text is not held, and no indicator, target, budget or progress report from it appears anywhere. The institutional movement around statistics has been real - [oversight of the office transferred by decree in November 2025](2025-11-13-joradp-jo75-decret-25-293-tutelle-ons) - and none of it is stated to be under the strategy.

progress: No change, a first stated position with no earlier account behind it
summary: A [national unique identification number is governed by decree](2023-09-13-dza-nin-decret-23-316) and the [automated civil status register was created in 2014](2014-08-20-dza-etat-civil-rnaec-loi-14-08).
developments:
The identifier the estate is built to use is [governed by an executive decree of 6 September 2023](2023-09-13-dza-nin-decret-23-316).

The register beneath it was [created by article 25 bis of the 2014 law amending the 1970 ordinance on civil status](2014-08-20-dza-etat-civil-rnaec-loi-14-08), and its [digitalisation was presented at the annual regional meeting of civil-registry directors general in July 2026](2026-07-01-dza-uneca-egmrg-crvs-digitalisation).

No population coverage figure, record count or issuance total for the identifier is published at any point, so the instruments are established and their reach is not.

summary: The [register's digitalisation was presented to the regional directors' meeting](2026-07-01-dza-uneca-egmrg-crvs-digitalisation) in July 2026, and an [appointment platform was reported](2025-11-23-dza-aps-etat-civil-plateforme-rdv).
developments:
The register was [created by article 25 bis of the 2014 law amending the 1970 ordinance](2014-08-20-dza-etat-civil-rnaec-loi-14-08).

2025-11-23 - [an appointment platform for civil-status services was reported](2025-11-23-dza-aps-etat-civil-plateforme-rdv).

2026-07 - [the register's digitalisation was presented at the annual regional meeting of civil-registry directors general](2026-07-01-dza-uneca-egmrg-crvs-digitalisation), alongside the mandatory acceptance of electronic civil-status documents this ledger holds separately. No coverage rate, document volume or completeness figure accompanies any of it.

summary: The national address register is [reaching one province at a time](2026-06-26-dza-icilinfo-mostaganem-rna-ateliers), on a [2022 procedures guide](2022-06-01-dza-rna-guide-procedures-adressage).
developments:
The standard is a [national addressing procedures guide of June 2022 setting a data model and procedural standard](2022-06-01-dza-rna-guide-procedures-adressage) - not just a registry fact but a national data model.

2026-05-09 - [generalisation was launched in one southern province](2026-05-09-dza-lavoiedalgerie-timimoun-rna).

2026-06-26 - [a two-day workshop series for district officials ran in a northern province, convened by the national addressing commission](2026-06-26-dza-icilinfo-mostaganem-rna-ateliers).

Two provinces in two months is the observed pace, and no coverage figure, address count or completion date is published against a country of 58.

summary: The 2025 revision closed with [24,503,060 registered electors](2026-01-14-dza-aps-anie-24-5-millions-electeurs), and [the system was reformed by organic law](2026-04-04-joradp-loi-organique-26-05-reforme-electorale) in April 2026.
developments:
The register's legal regime is set by [the organic ordinance of 10 March 2021 on the electoral system](2021-03-10-dza-ordonnance-21-01-regime-electoral) - a statute establishing the regime, not merely a fact about the register.

2026-01-14 - the electoral authority announced the completed 2025 periodic revision: [24,503,060 registered electors](2026-01-14-dza-aps-anie-24-5-millions-electeurs).

2026-04-04 - an organic law reformed the system around it: [one third of candidate-list seats reserved for women, at least one half for candidates under 40, and state financing for independent young candidates](2026-04-04-joradp-loi-organique-26-05-reforme-electorale). No biometric or deduplication measure for the register itself is held.

summary: The [2018 law's prior-authorisation and adequacy regime](2018-06-10-dza-jo-2018-034-loi-18-07-protection-donnees-personnelles) was carried into the [amending law of July 2025](2025-07-24-dz-joradp-loi-25-11-protection-donnees).
developments:
The founding act [created the data-protection authority and, at chapter IV and notably article 44, set the prior-authorisation and adequacy regime governing transfers abroad](2018-06-10-dza-jo-2018-034-loi-18-07-protection-donnees-personnelles).

2025-07-24 - [the amending law carried the regime forward](2025-07-24-dz-joradp-loi-25-11-protection-donnees), in a gazette issue that also carries a virtual-assets amendment to the anti-money-laundering law.

The authority's [own compliance guide describes an operational portal and states that processing involving transfer requires its authorisation](2026-01-01-dza-anpdp-guide-responsable-traitements). No adequacy decision, authorisation count or refusal is published, so the regime's operation cannot be checked.

summary: A [national data-governance system was launched](2026-02-09-radioalgerienne-lancement-dispositif-gouvernance-donnees) in February 2026 under a presidential decree of December 2025.
developments:
2026-02-09 - the prime minister [launched the national data-governance system established by a presidential decree of 30 December 2025](2026-02-09-radioalgerienne-lancement-dispositif-gouvernance-donnees).

The trust-services law of February 2026 is the other enabling instrument: it [establishes the national trust-service and electronic-identification framework across 116 articles and requires trust-service-provider data to be hosted nationally](2026-02-17-dza-jo-2026-014-loi-26-02-services-confiance-identification-electronique).

Neither is accompanied by an operating rule, a participating body, a dataset exchanged or a service built on it, so what is established is the legal frame and not its use.

progress: No change, a first stated position with no earlier account behind it
summary: A [national information-security referential covers 14 domains](2020-01-01-mpt-rnsi-referentiel-securite-information); no interoperability standard is held.
developments:
The clearest national technical standard the base holds is [an information-security referential covering 14 domains including asset management, access control, cloud-services security and incident handling](2020-01-01-mpt-rnsi-referentiel-securite-information). It is security, not interoperability.

The addressing side does have one: [the national addressing procedures guide sets a data model and procedural standard](2022-06-01-dza-rna-guide-procedures-adressage).

No whole-of-government interoperability framework, message standard or conformity test appears anywhere, and the national interoperability system this ledger holds separately is a system rather than a standard.

summary: The standardisation body [published a draft national work programme for 2026](2026-02-01-dza-ianor-projet-programme-national-normalisation-2026); no count of standards in force is held.
developments:
The body was [created as a public establishment by decree of 21 February 1998, taking standardisation over from the industrial property institute](1998-02-21-dza-jo-1998-011-decret-98-69-creation-ianor).

2026-02 - it [published a draft national standardisation work programme for 2026](2026-02-01-dza-ianor-projet-programme-national-normalisation-2026). It is explicitly a draft work programme, not a record of adopted standards, and the base holds no count of standards in force, no adoption rate and no conformity-assessment output.

The national accreditation and conformity network this ledger holds separately is the other half of the quality infrastructure, and neither is measured.

summary: A [first regulation dedicated to payment service providers](2025-05-07-joradp-jo28-reglement-25-02-psp) was followed by one [bringing them inside the anti-money-laundering regime](2025-10-14-joradp-jo68-reglement-25-14-aml-psp).
developments:
The umbrella statute is [the monetary and banking law of June 2023, whose article 166 repealed the prior ordinance](2023-06-27-dza-loi-23-09-monetaire-bancaire).

2025-04-14 - [the first Algerian regulatory instrument specifically dedicated to payment service providers was adopted by the central bank](2025-05-07-joradp-jo28-reglement-25-02-psp).

2025-09-24 - [a second regulation explicitly brings payment service providers inside the anti-money-laundering regime](2025-10-14-joradp-jo68-reglement-25-14-aml-psp), and in November the banking commission [issued guidelines on virtual assets](2025-11-23-dza-aps-boa-actifs-virtuels). No licence granted under the provider regime is recorded.

summary: The tax directorate [launched remote electronic payment](2026-07-25-dz-aps-paiement-electronique-jibayatic) in July 2026, completing the declare-and-pay path online.
developments:
The tax portal was established under [the 2022 finance law](2021-12-30-dz-joradp-loi-21-16-lf2022-jibayatic), and the directorate's own [guidance on opening a tax file is the public-facing description of how a taxpayer enters the register it runs on](2023-11-10-dza-dgi-ouvrir-dossier-fiscal-nif).

2026-01-21 - [remote declaration became obligatory](2026-01-21-dz-aps-teledeclaration-obligatoire-jibayatic).

2026-07-25 - [remote electronic payment was launched](2026-07-25-dz-aps-paiement-electronique-jibayatic), and a joint finance and commerce protocol had [launched electronic payment of stamp duties for commercial-register formalities in December 2025](2025-12-24-dza-aps-tabioucom-droits-timbre). No transaction volume or take-up figure is published.

summary: The pension fund [replaced the paper life certificate with facial recognition](2026-05-12-aps-certificat-de-vie-reconnaissance-faciale) and credited arrears to [more than 3.5 million accounts](2026-05-02-dza-aps-cnr-versement-pensions).
developments:
2026-05-12 - [the pension fund replaced the paper life certificate with a facial-recognition verification system for pensioners](2026-05-12-aps-certificat-de-vie-reconnaissance-faciale) - a biometric check substituting for an in-person one, with no accuracy, exception or appeal route published.

2026-05-02 - [pension-increase arrears were credited to the accounts of more than 3.5 million retirees and beneficiaries](2026-05-02-dza-aps-cnr-versement-pensions), on a [partnership the fund signed with a state bank in January 2026](2026-01-01-dza-aps-cnr-bdl-convention).

The other transfer on the record is [a solidarity allowance and its beneficiary framework, established by decree in October 2024](2024-10-09-dza-decret-24-325-afs-fichier-beneficiaires).

progress: No change, a first stated position with no earlier account behind it
summary: The travel foreign-exchange allowance [moved onto a nominative card](2026-07-14-elwatan-instruction-07-2026-droit-de-change-carte); no payments consumer-protection instrument is held.
developments:
2026-07-13 - a central bank instruction [moves the travel foreign-exchange allowance onto a nominative card](2026-07-14-elwatan-instruction-07-2026-droit-de-change-carte), quoted verbatim in the reporting; the instrument's own text is not held.

That is a change to how a payment instrument is issued rather than a protection for the person using it. No complaint channel, chargeback rule, fraud-reimbursement obligation or dispute-resolution route for electronic payments appears anywhere on this ledger, and the payment service provider regime made in 2025 is not stated to carry one.

summary: Equipped international capacity [exceeds 10.2 terabits per second](2026-01-15-dza-radioalgerie-zerrouki-bande-passante-internationale), up from 1.5 in early 2020.
developments:
2026-01-15 - the minister told parliament that [equipped international bandwidth capacity now exceeds 10.2 terabits per second, against 1.5 terabits in early 2020](2026-01-15-dza-radioalgerie-zerrouki-bande-passante-internationale) - close to a sevenfold rise over six years, on the minister's own figures.

2025-10-23 - the minister [gave the go-ahead for a submarine fibre-optic cable project departing from the capital's port, intended to expand the routes available](2025-10-23-dza-aps-lancement-projet-cable-sous-marin-medusa).

What is not published is utilisation: no figure for how much of the equipped capacity carries traffic, and no wholesale price, appears on this ledger.

progress: No change, a first stated position with no earlier account behind it
summary: The regulator published [a decision on the interconnection catalogue](2025-10-27-dza-arpce-bulletin-08-2025-decision-47-catalogue-interconnexion-atm); no retail tariff or basket figure is held.
developments:
The wholesale side is regulated and on the record: [the regulator's bulletin of October 2025 carries a decision on the interconnection catalogue among at least a dozen decisions taken between June and October 2025](2025-10-27-dza-arpce-bulletin-08-2025-decision-47-catalogue-interconnexion-atm), and [the incumbent's fixed-network licence was renewed by executive decree with its annexed specification](2026-04-19-joradp-jo29-decret-26-144-licence-at).

The retail side is not. No mobile tariff, data-basket price, price index or affordability measure against income appears anywhere on this ledger, so what a subscriber pays cannot be stated.

progress: No change, a first stated position with no earlier account behind it
summary: The first national data centre [obtained a tier III design classification](2026-02-22-aps-data-center-tier-iii-certification); no second site or replication is held.
developments:
2026-02-22 - [the country's first national data centre obtained a tier III design classification from the international certifying body](2026-02-22-aps-data-center-tier-iii-certification) - the first external assurance of the government storage estate the base holds.

A tier III design classification concerns concurrent maintainability at one site. It says nothing about a second site, and no geographically separated facility, replication arrangement, recovery objective or tested restore appears anywhere on this ledger - which is what off-site backup would mean.

summary: More than [1,850 megawatts were added before the 2026 summer peak](2026-06-18-aps-sonelgaz-1850mw-ete-2026), and the [network control system is to be rehabilitated from 2026](2025-10-30-aps-scada-rehabilitation).
developments:
The regulator's own procedure for [monitoring transmission service quality and continuity was set by decision of 22 November 2017](2017-11-22-creg-decision-d05-17-cd-service-quality); no measurement made under it appears on the base.

2025-10-30 - the energy minister announced that [the transmission and distribution telecontrol and monitoring system would be rehabilitated starting 2026](2025-10-30-aps-scada-rehabilitation).

2026-06 - [more than 1,850 megawatts of generation capacity were added ahead of the summer peak](2026-06-18-aps-sonelgaz-1850mw-ete-2026) and [the distribution utility mobilised resources for continuous supply in the capital](2026-06-22-aps-algiers-distribution-capacite). No interruption index is published.

progress: No change, a first stated position with no earlier account behind it
summary: The minister put the country's [energy position as a competitiveness argument for hosting data centres](2025-03-03-mpt-ai-data-centre-energy-competitiveness); no load figure is held.
developments:
2025-03 - the telecommunications minister [put the country's energy position as a competitiveness argument for hosting data centres, at an international artificial-intelligence ministerial summit](2025-03-03-mpt-ai-data-centre-energy-competitiveness).

That is a pitch rather than a measurement. No load figure, tariff, power-purchase arrangement or water requirement for any facility appears anywhere on this ledger, and the power supply and resilience arrangements for the data-centre estate that this ledger holds separately carry none either.

On the supply side, [more than 1,850 megawatts were added before the 2026 summer peak](2026-06-18-aps-sonelgaz-1850mw-ete-2026), with no allocation to digital infrastructure stated.

summary: A [remote patient-record monitoring platform is stated to be in place](2026-04-11-dz-aps-plateforme-suivi-distance-dossiers-medicaux), and the sector was [onboarded to national cloud services](2025-12-05-dza-aps-convention-sante-hcn-cloud-computing-national).
developments:
2025-10 - [an electronic patient record was reported](2025-10-18-dz-aps-dossier-electronique-patient), and in December [a patient transfer platform](2025-12-11-aps-plateforme-transferts-patients).

2025-12-05 - [the health sector was onboarded to national cloud services under a convention with the digitalisation commission](2025-12-05-dza-aps-convention-sante-hcn-cloud-computing-national) - the enablement beneath any exchange between health systems.

2026-04-11 - the health minister states [a remote patient-record monitoring platform was recently put in place](2026-04-11-dz-aps-plateforme-suivi-distance-dossiers-medicaux). No facility count, record count or statement that any two of these systems exchange data accompanies any of them.

progress: No change, a first stated position with no earlier account behind it
summary: An [electronic land-title system](2026-02-24-joradp-jo15-arrete-bdd-stupefiants) is on the ledger; the only new sectoral database made this window is for controlled substances.
developments:
The land side of the base is the electronic land-title system this ledger already holds, and nothing in this window touched it: no parcel count, registration volume or processing time is published for it.

The one new sectoral database made in the window is elsewhere: [a ministerial order of 10 February 2026 amends a December 2024 order to create a real-time automated national database on controlled substances](2026-02-24-joradp-jo15-arrete-bdd-stupefiants), with no operator, data set or start date published.

It is recorded here because it shows the instrument type the land estate has not received.

summary: A [ministerial order addresses information and educational technology in secondary education](2026-03-24-dz-joradp-arrete-informatique-tice-secondaire), and [tablets are being generalised](2026-02-03-dz-education-generalisation-tablettes).
