developments:
The standing statutory frame is [the education orientation law of 27 January 2008](2008-01-27-dz-joradp-loi-08-04-orientation-education).

2026-02-02 - the minister [briefed parliament's education committee on generalising tablets among other sectoral measures](2026-02-03-dz-education-generalisation-tablettes).

2026-03-24 - [a ministerial order addresses information technology and educational technology in secondary education](2026-03-24-dz-joradp-arrete-informatique-tice-secondaire).

The connectivity beneath it is a convention: [the incumbent operator signed one in July 2024 to connect primary schools](2024-07-04-dz-algerietelecom-convention-ecoles-primaires). No pupil, school or teacher count is published against any of it.

progress: No change, a first stated position with no earlier account behind it
summary: The incumbent operator [signed a convention to connect primary schools](2024-07-04-dz-algerietelecom-convention-ecoles-primaires) in July 2024; no rural figure is held.
developments:
2024-07-04 - [the incumbent operator signed a convention to connect primary schools](2024-07-04-dz-algerietelecom-convention-ecoles-primaires). It is the base's only entry on primary-school connectivity and it names no rural target.

2026-02 - the education minister's [briefing to parliament on generalising tablets](2026-02-03-dz-education-generalisation-tablettes) is national rather than rural.

No count of schools connected, no rural-urban split, and no measure of what a rural school can do with a connection appears anywhere on this ledger, so the position is a signed convention and two years of silence after it.

summary: A [national doctoral school in quantum computing opened](2025-09-30-dz-aps-ecole-doctorale-informatique-quantique) and a [university digital library launched](2025-10-20-dz-mesrs-bibliotheque-numerique-universitaire).
developments:
The sector runs on [a digital master plan with seven named axes, issued in October 2022](2022-10-24-mesrs-schema-directeur-numerique).

2025-09-30 - [the country's first national doctoral school in quantum computing was launched](2025-09-30-dz-aps-ecole-doctorale-informatique-quantique).

2025-10-20 - [a university digital library was launched](2025-10-20-dz-mesrs-bibliotheque-numerique-universitaire), and in December [information-security training was run for staff](2025-12-09-mesrs-formation-cadres-securite-si).

2026-06-28 - [a high council for the scientific community abroad was constituted](2026-06-28-dza-mesrs-haut-conseil-communaute-scientifique-etranger). No enrolment, graduate or qualification count is published against any of it.

summary: [Four training sessions were run for finance ministry cadres](2026-05-04-dz-undp-renforcement-competences-finances) in May 2026; no whole-of-government measure is held.
developments:
2026-05 - [four training sessions were run jointly by a development agency and the finance ministry for its cadres, on change management among other subjects](2026-05-04-dz-undp-renforcement-competences-finances).

2025-11 - [the national school of administration's own training programme was gazetted](2025-11-16-dz-joradp-arrete-ena-programme-formation), and in February 2026 [a vocational-training cybersecurity seminar was held](2026-02-10-mvet-seminaire-cybersecurite).

Each is one ministry or one event. No civil-service digital skills assessment, no headcount trained across government and no competence framework appears anywhere on this ledger.

summary: A [2025 statute requires accessibility of public services, spaces and communications](2025-02-23-joradp-loi-25-01-protection-personnes-besoins-specifiques), and [assessment was reorganised](2026-05-06-joradp-decrets-26-146-26-147-commission-medicale-recours).
developments:
2025-02-20 - the overarching disability-inclusion statute [requires accessibility of public services, spaces and information and communications](2025-02-23-joradp-loi-25-01-protection-personnes-besoins-specifiques).

2026-04-05 - decrees [reorganised disability assessment: a 15-day maximum decision period, 48-hour notification, home visits where the person cannot travel, and a national appeal commission](2026-05-06-joradp-decrets-26-146-26-147-commission-medicale-recours).

The statute's accessibility requirement covers communications, and no accessibility standard for public digital services, no conformity test and no compliance measure follows from it on the record.

progress: No change, a first stated position with no earlier account behind it
summary: The finance ministry's [budget reform programme lists citizen participation in budget policy](2024-04-02-mf-gov-dz-modernisation-systemes-budgetaires); no consultation is recorded.
developments:
The ministry's page on the organic budget law reform programme [explicitly lists citizen participation in the preparation of budget policies among its aims](2024-04-02-mf-gov-dz-modernisation-systemes-budgetaires).

No consultation, submission count, published response or participation mechanism follows from it anywhere on this ledger.

The nearest working channel is a grievance one rather than a policy one: the ombudsman [named digitisation of the citizen complaints register as a priority](2026-05-24-dz-aps-numerisation-registre-doleances) in May 2026, and the virtual citizen reception this ledger holds separately carries no volume figure.

progress: No change, a first stated position with no earlier account behind it
summary: The [media organic law requires public bodies to facilitate journalists' access to information](2023-08-29-joradp-jo56-loi-organique-23-14-information); no general right-to-information statute is held.
developments:
The [organic law of 27 August 2023 governing media and information activity includes provisions requiring public bodies to facilitate journalists' access to information](2023-08-29-joradp-jo56-loi-organique-23-14-information).

That is a press-access provision inside a media statute, not a general right of access. No right-to-information law, no request procedure, no refusal ground and no appeal route open to a citizen appears anywhere on this ledger, and no request, refusal or appeal under the media law's provisions is recorded either.

summary: The national assembly [oversaw a technical presentation of artificial-intelligence transcription](2026-03-15-dz-aps-ia-transcription-apn) for its proceedings in March 2026.
developments:
2026-03 - the president of the national assembly [oversaw a technical presentation of an artificial-intelligence transcription capability for parliamentary proceedings](2026-03-15-dz-aps-ia-transcription-apn). No adoption, supplier or language coverage is published.

2026-05-25 - a government meeting chaired by the prime minister [was devoted to examining the draft national artificial-intelligence strategy](2026-05-25-dz-aps-strategie-nationale-ia); no text or adoption follows on the record.

One presentation to a legislature and one draft strategy is the whole of artificial-intelligence use in administration the base holds.

progress: No change, a first stated position with no earlier account behind it
summary: The data-protection authority [convened a study day at which artificial intelligence was one theme](2025-11-24-dz-aps-anpdp-protection-donnees-ia); no rule or enforcement follows.
developments:
2025-11-24 - [the data-protection authority convened a study day at which artificial intelligence was one of several themes discussed](2025-11-24-dz-aps-anpdp-protection-donnees-ia). Its own compliance guide [describes an operational portal for controllers](2026-01-01-dza-anpdp-guide-responsable-traitements), and neither carries a deliberation or guidance on artificial intelligence.

The one artificial-intelligence law on this ledger is an ethical-AI law held separately, and the trust-services law of February 2026 [makes no mention of artificial intelligence across its 116 articles](2026-02-17-joradp-loi-26-02-identification-electronique).

No enforcement action, complaint or prohibited use is recorded anywhere.
